title: Grade 4 Math — Tue, Jun 17
description: Geometry — Day 2 of 5: What is an angle? Right angles
subject: mathematics

questions.question: An angle is formed when:
options: Two rays share a common endpoint (vertex)
questions.explanation: An angle is formed when two rays meet at a common point called the vertex. The two rays are the arms (sides) of the angle.

questions.question: The unit for measuring angles is:
questions.explanation: Angles are measured in degrees (°). A full rotation is 360°.

questions.question: A right angle measures exactly:
questions.explanation: A right angle = 90°. It looks like the corner of a square. It is formed when two perpendicular lines meet.

questions.question: Which symbol is used to show a right angle in a diagram?
options: A small square at the vertex
questions.explanation: A small square drawn at the vertex indicates a right angle (90°) in geometry diagrams.

questions.question: How many right angles does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 right angles (4 × 90° = 360°, a full turn).

questions.question: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle also has 4 right angles, just like a square.

questions.question: Which of these is a right angle in everyday life?
options: The angle between clock hands at 3 o'clock
The opening of a book at 45°
questions.explanation: At 3 o'clock, the hour hand and minute hand are at exactly 90° — a right angle.

questions.question: A straight angle measures:
questions.explanation: A straight angle = 180°. It looks like a straight line. Two right angles placed together form a straight angle.

questions.question: A complete (full) rotation is:
questions.explanation: A full rotation (going all the way around) = 360°. Like spinning a full circle.

questions.question: How many right angles make a straight angle (180°)?
How many right angles make a complete turn (360°)?
A door is opened halfway from fully closed. The angle formed is approximately:
questions.explanation: When a door is opened to a right angle position, the angle between the door and the wall is 90°.

questions.question: Look at a clock: at 6 o'clock, the angle between the two hands is:
questions.explanation: At 6 o'clock, the hour hand points down (6) and the minute hand points up (12). They form a straight line = 180°.

questions.question: The corner of your textbook forms a ___ angle.
questions.explanation: The corner of a textbook/notebook is a right angle (90°). You can verify with a set square.

questions.question: The vertex of an angle is:
options: The common endpoint where the two rays meet
questions.explanation: The vertex is the common endpoint where the two rays (arms) of the angle meet.
